patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a two-column grid with asymmetrical widths, often pairing a large image or graphic with a text block, creating dynamic visual balance.
A strong contrast between oversized, authoritative serif headings and quotes, and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, establishes a sophisticated yet modern voice.
The site uses a predominantly neutral palette of light grey, black, and white, punctuated by large, bold blocks of neon yellow and deep purple as primary accent colors.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to key sections.
Large, full-width testimonial sections feature a prominent, centrally aligned quote in a large serif font, accompanied by a portrait and attribution.

technique_notes: A fixed header element is used to keep the main navigation persistently visible at the top of the screen during scroll.
Content is structured using flexible grid layouts that allow for varied column proportions, often presenting images and text in an offset or asymmetrical arrangement.

Specific sections or interior pages feature complex, generative background graphics, such as grid patterns or abstract ASCII-art like designs, which are likely rendered dynamically using a canvas element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) and quotes contrast with a clean, smaller sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between major sections, with balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold, almost brutalist application of neon accent colors (yellow and purple) in large, interactive blocks, set against a minimal, editorial-style layout. This unexpected combination creates a high-contrast, modern yet authoritative aesthetic that feels both sophisticated and visually striking.
